title: High-Protein Beefy 5-Layer Burritos
summary: A homemade Taco Bell-style 5-layer burrito: taco-seasoned lean beef with refried beans and cheese, over a Greek-yoghurt queso sauce in a toasted low-carb tortilla. Makes 7 for meal prep.

steps.text: Cook 2 lb lean minced beef with 2 packets of Taco Bell seasoning, breaking it up as it browns.
While it cooks, stir in 1 can of refried beans and 1 bag of fat-free cheese.
Mix 280 g Greek yoghurt, 240 g Tostitos cheese dip and 20 g Taco Bell sauce into a smooth nacho cheese sauce.
Lay out the 7 tortillas. Spread the queso sauce on first, in a circular motion, keeping about an inch from the edges.
Add the beef filling, fold into burritos, and toast them until golden.
Pack them into containers for the week.

nutrition.note: The description marks these as estimated. The voiceover says 52 g protein.

The video shows the beans and cheese going into the pan with the beef. The queso is spread on the tortilla first, then the beef goes on top.
